A full groom, in order

What happens while you are away.

Every groom is tailored to the individual dog and done to your specification, with gentle handling and professional technique. Times vary with each dog’s coat.

  1. 1

    Bath time

    A perfect water temperature and shampoos to suit your dog, including a degrease shampoo for those ‘loving life’ ears and a marshmallow facial wash to safely clean and brighten those doggy chops.

  2. 2

    Fluffy and dry

    A professional blaster takes away most of the water and any loose, dead hair, then a lighter hair dryer finishes the job. For a more nervous dog the dryers are turned down and it may take a little longer. Just means more cuddles for them and us.

  3. 3

    Clippers and scissors

    A range of clipping and scissor techniques to get your dog comfortable and looking their best, always to your specification. If there is matting, the affected areas need clipping for your dog’s comfort, and the groomer will explain the best option first.

  4. 4

    Nails, ears, eyes

    Every dog gets a mani pedi: nails trimmed as much as possible, ears cleaned and plucked if needed, eyes cleaned, and anal glands expressed if you ask. Irritated areas are cleaned with Leucillin, an animal antiseptic.

  5. 5

    A spritz of pawfume

    Your dog ends their groom with a few sprays of a natural, lovely smelling pawfume.

Matted coat? There is a separate de-matting service.

Mats pull on the skin and can be painful to brush out, so they are clipped off with care. Prices and bookings are given after a consultation with you and your dog. It is up to 1 hour for £40, then £15 per extra half hour, to a maximum of 3 hours, and does not include a bath or groom. There is no need to feel embarrassed, say Rebecca and Elaine.

Before you book

Meet them first, if your dog needs it.

Plush Puppies is owned and run by Rebecca, with her colleague Elaine. Rebecca has over 20 years of experience working with animals, including 15 years as a professional dog groomer. Elaine brings over 6 years of grooming experience.

Nervous, anxious or reactive dogs can have one-to-one sessions, and free pre-grooming visits for puppies, dogs and owners are available so everyone can have a sniff around first.

  • Cage free, just soft beds
  • Fully heated and air conditioned
  • Secure private garden
  • Natural products for skin and coat
  • Emmi-pet teeth cleaning
  • Gift vouchers and loyalty schemes
